config.source:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', transaction_date) AS month,
    SUM(net_amount) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecommerce.gold.fact_transactions_denorm
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  month,
  net_revenue,
  LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_revenue,
  CASE
    WHEN LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) IS NULL OR LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (net_revenue - LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)
  END AS mom_growth_rate
FROM monthly_revenue

WITH category_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    category_name,
    SUM(net_amount) AS category_revenue
  FROM ecommerce.gold.fact_transactions_denorm
  GROUP BY category_name
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS total_revenue
  FROM ecommerce.gold.fact_transactions_denorm
)
SELECT
  cr.category_name,
  cr.category_revenue,
  gt.total_revenue,
  cr.category_revenue / gt.total_revenue AS pct_of_total
FROM category_revenue cr
CROSS JOIN grand_total gt

SELECT product_id, SUM(net_amount) AS revenue
FROM ecommerce.gold.fact_transactions_denorm
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH product_revenue AS (
  SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_amount) AS revenue
  FROM ecommerce.gold.fact_transactions_denorm
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT category_name, product_id, revenue,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rank
  FROM product_revenue
)
SELECT category_name, product_id, revenue, rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY category_name, rank

SELECT brand_name, SUM(net_amount) / COUNT(*) AS avg_transaction_value
FROM ecommerce.gold.fact_transactions_denorm
GROUP BY brand_name
ORDER BY avg_transaction_value DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT brand_name, SUM(net_amount) AS revenue
FROM ecommerce.gold.fact_transactions_denorm
GROUP BY brand_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM ecommerce.gold.fact_transactions_denorm
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT customer_id, SUM(net_amount) AS total_spending
FROM ecommerce.gold.fact_transactions_denorm
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY total_spending DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT coupon_code, SUM(net_amount) AS revenue
FROM ecommerce.gold.fact_transactions_denorm
WHERE coupon_flag = 1
GROUP BY coupon_code
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT coupon_code, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM ecommerce.gold.fact_transactions_denorm
WHERE coupon_flag = 1
GROUP BY coupon_code
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  ROUND(discount_percent, 1) AS discount_pct,
  SUM(net_amount) AS revenue
FROM ecommerce.gold.fact_transactions_denorm
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
